character.description: One young Saudi man seen only in profile and from behind, calm and composed, face kept mostly in shadow as he crosses the frame and exits into darkness.

character.hair: Short black hair with a tight skin fade at the sides, neatly styled and slightly longer on top
character.grooming: Neatly trimmed black beard with a sharp, clean line along the cheek and neck, clean eyebrows
character.build: Lean athletic build, broad shoulders, upright confident posture, around 178 cm tall
wardrobe: Dark charcoal-black tailored jacket with structured shoulders and a subtle fabric sheen
Black fitted crew-neck knit top under the jacket
No visible logos, no jewelry except a slim dark watch with a plain unmarked face

product.name: the fragrance
